summary: Frontend regression testing for the CoinQuest marketing site restructure (retiring old LandingPage, moving FinancialLiteracyPage to '/', adding shared SiteHeader/SiteFooter with new Pricing/How-It-Works nav). All 25+ verification checks passed.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility, non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: SiteHeader scrollToSection uses a fixed 400ms setTimeout after navigate('/'). On slow devices/networks the target section may not yet be mounted and the scroll silently no-ops. Consider using a MutationObserver or requestAnimationFrame loop with retry.
SiteHeader has no mobile hamburger menu -- on very narrow viewports the nav wraps below the logo which works but is not ideal. Not a bug for this change, but worth noting.
DialogContent (SchoolEnquiryDialog) missing aria-describedby -- minor a11y warning in console.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) '/' now serves FinancialLiteracyPage with hero 'Learn Money Skills While Having Fun!'. (2) '/financial-literacy' correctly redirects to '/'. (3) SiteHeader present on /, /entrepreneurship-workshop, /for-schools with EXACTLY two nav testids [site-header-nav-pricing, site-header-nav-how-it-works] -- no Workshop/Platform/For Schools nav buttons. (4) CTA is contextual: 'Sign Up' on /, 'Book a Free Trial' on /entrepreneurship-workshop, 'Enquire Now' on /for-schools (opens dialog). (5) Home Pricing click scrolls to #pricing; How It Works scrolls to #how-it-works (walkthrough video is configured). (6) Cross-page Pricing click from /entrepreneurship-workshop navigates to / correctly. (7) SiteFooter present on all 3 public pages with all 3 quick links (platform/workshop/for-schools) + Contact + Visit Learners' Planet. Footer link navigation works. (8) session_expired=true toast shows and URL cleaned to '/'. (9) Home CTA routes to /signup. No regressions detected.
